description: Does this appointment fit: opening hours in the venue's zone, closed days, existing bookings with buffers, minimum notice — Checks one proposed appointment (instant + duration) against a venue's local opening hours per weekday, closed dates or a named holiday calendar, up to 500 existing bookings with a buffer on each side, and a minimum notice measured from a caller-supplied asOf; every violated rule is returned as a witness with the conflicting booking or hour block. Local hours are resolved in the venue's IANA zone

bufferMinutes.description: Required gap on each side of the appointment.

calendar.description: Optional named holiday calendar for closed days (unsupported outside its range). Without it only holidays/weekend you list apply; hours decide the weekdays.

holidays.description: Extra non-business dates YYYY-MM-DD (company closures, a calendar we do not carry).

close.description: Exclusive end, local; must be after open (no overnight blocks).

timeZone.description: Venue zone in which hours apply.

weekend.description: Ignored for hours; with a named calendar only its holidays are used.

name: appointment-fit
